descriptions: Prioritize safety: maximize separation between UAVs, avoid all collision risks even at the cost of slower task completion
Maximize efficiency: complete all assigned tasks as quickly as possible, accept moderate collision risk
Balanced approach: equal weight on task completion speed and collision avoidance
Energy conservation: minimize movement and acceleration, prefer slow steady trajectories
Aggressive task pursuit: charge directly at targets, minimal detour for obstacle avoidance
Cautious exploration: move slowly, maintain safe distances, prioritize gathering situational awareness
Load balancing: distribute work evenly across all UAVs, avoid overloading any single unit
Formation keeping: maintain geometric formation while approaching targets as a group
Threat avoidance: actively steer clear of threat zones and radar coverage areas
Threat engagement: deliberately enter threat zones to engage high-value targets
Perimeter patrol: circle the operational boundary, intercept targets at the edge
Center rush: all UAVs converge rapidly to the center of the operational area
Decentralized sweep: each UAV covers its own sector independently
Relay coordination: UAVs take turns approaching targets while others provide overwatch
Minimum communication: operate with implicit coordination, minimal mutual awareness
Full coordination: maintain tight awareness of all other UAV positions and intentions
Altitude separation: use vertical spacing as primary collision avoidance strategy
Speed modulation: vary individual speeds to create temporal separation at crossing points
Reactive avoidance: only take evasive action when collision is imminent
Predictive planning: anticipate future conflicts several steps ahead and adjust early
Target prioritization: focus on the nearest target first, then move to the next
Coverage maximization: spread out to maximize spatial coverage of the operational area
Stealth approach: minimize detectability by reducing speed and avoiding threat zones
Rapid response: maximum acceleration to reach targets, accept energy cost
Hover and observe: station-keep at safe altitude, only move when target is clearly identified
